voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited has approved the allotment of 10,377,358 fully paid-up equity shares to Qualified Institutional Buyers. The Board of Directors approved this on November 18, 2026. The shares were allotted at Rs. 265 per share. This price is at a discount of Rs. 4.205, or 1.56 percent, to the floor price of Rs. 269.205. The total amount raised is Rs. 2,75,00,00,000. The issue opened on November 12, 2026, and closed on November 18, 2026. The company's paid-up equity share capital has increased to 13,53,74,746 shares. Rajasthan Global Securities Pvt Ltd received 28,41,700 shares. Craft Emerging Market Fund Arbitrage Strategy Fund received 10,94,339 shares. Elite Capital Fund received 10,94,339 shares. Zeal Global Opportunities Fund received 9,36,860 shares. The shareholding pattern will be submitted with the listing application.

voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited has approved the allotment of 10,377,358 fully paid-up equity shares to Qualified Institutional Buyers. The Board of Directors approved this allotment on November 18, 2026. The shares were issued at a price of Rs. 265 per share. This amount includes a premium of Rs. 264 per share. The total aggregation is up to Rs. 2,75,00,00,000. The issue opened on November 12, 2026. It closed on November 18, 2026. The price represents a discount of 1.56 percent to the floor price of Rs. 269.205. Following this allotment, the paid-up equity share capital stands at Rs. 13,53,74,746. This consists of 13,53,74,746 equity shares of Rs. 1 each. The company will submit the shareholding pattern along with the listing application. A list of allottees holding more than 5 percent is attached.

attchmntText: Agi Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals
voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited received License Number MTP/2253 dated 18.11.2026 from the Municipal Corporation, Jalandhar for the development of the first phase of its Group Housing Project AGI Gateway. The project is located in a premium residential area in Jalandhar and comprises 460 flats, including 152 four-bedroom units and 308 three-bedroom units. The license is valid until November 17, 2031. The company states that this approval will further strengthen its financial position. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Agi Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 18, 2026.
voiceSummary: AGI Infra Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 18, 2026. The Board approved the closure of the Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares. The issue price for 1,03,77,358 equity shares was determined at Rs. 265 per share. This price represents a discount of Rs. 4.205, or 1.56 percent, to the floor price of Rs. 269.205. The Board also adopted the Placement Document dated November 18, 2026. Additionally, the Confirmation of Allocation Note for eligible Qualified Institutional Buyers was approved and finalized. The Board meeting commenced at 4:00 P.M. IST and concluded at 5:00 P.M. IST on the same day. The company has filed the Placement Document with the exchange. A copy of the document is available on the company website.
